policies.source: forbid(principal == Scanner::"local", action == Action::"passScan", resource == Scan::"current") when { context.by_category.secrets.critical > 0 };
permit(principal == Scanner::"local", action == Action::"warnScan", resource == Scan::"current") when { context.by_category.sast.high > 0 };
forbid(principal == Scanner::"local", action == Action::"passScan", resource == Scan::"current") when { context.category.cve > 5 };
